text.en:
Effective January 1, 1984, the following positions in the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) shall
have the salary herein provided:
1) NBI Chief Legal Officer
2) NBI Assistant Chief Legal Officer
41,392.00
3) NBI Chief Research Attorney
41,392.00
4) NBI Senior Research Attorney
33,840.00
5) NBI Research Attorney III
32,196.00
6) NBI Legal Officer III
32,196.00
7) NBI Legal Officer II
27,732.00
8) NBI Legal Officer I
25,116.00

The Director of the NBI is hereby authorized to reorganize his legal and administrative staff within
three (3) months from the date of effectivity hereof in such manner as he may deem necessary or proper to
promote efficiency in the service. Any officer or employee who is not appointed by the Director of the NBI as
a result of the reorganization herein authorized, or who refuses his appointment, shall be paid the money value
of his accumulated vacation and sick leaves, and such retirement gratuity as may be due him under existing
retirement laws. Anyone not appointed who does not qualify under any existing retirement law may be paid

one month salary for every full year of service, a fraction of more than six (6) months being considered a full
year, payable in lump sum, from out of the salary lapses in the NBI.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Executive Order shall be taken from the salary
savings of the NBI.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 13th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
eighty-four.
